— 200
Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning successfully returned the HOCON file for the specified scan
configuration.
403
Returned if you do not have user permissions to export the specified scan configuration. For more
information, see Roles and Permissions.
404 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning could not find the specified configuration.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable Web App Scanning.
